'''Lexrul''' was an [[City/Legends|urban]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. 

During the [[Kymoodon Era]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], Lexrul was located beyond the frontier of the Republic. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] considered the colonization of Lexrul as an incursion into their [[Hutt Space/Legends|outlying domain]] and an act of war. In response, they launched an [[Assault on Lexrul|assault]] against Lexrul and deployed captured slaves from other colonies as [[cyborg berserker]]s into a ceremonial battle. Following this attack, the Republic issued a public advisory that warned against colonizing [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|rimward]] by detailing the horrors that occurred on Lexrul and other worlds. <ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref>
